news.text: 🚑 Alexander #Sørloth, the #AtléticoMadrid striker and a name that frequently comes back into #Juventus's orbit, has suffered an injury.It is not a super long-term injury, though the expectation of #Atlético's medical staff is not to see him back on the pitch at least until the start of 2027 - that is, until January.They are talking about more than a month on the sidelines.#JUVE▪️ #Juve is going to generate plenty of headlines regarding strikers in the month of January.▫️ They thought about #Sørloth several times over the summer: when there were issues with #KoloMuani, they kept him under consideration, before managing to sign #KoloMuani.▪️ #Juve would gladly sign that type of player: the phy

🗣 Jeremie #Boga to 'Sky Sport': "Are we shaking off the tension? Yes. When you win, it is easier to try things on the pitch and gain more confidence with these victories we are getting in Europe, and also the one against #Venezia gave us confidence. Now we have to keep pushing forward and find that consistency, starting matches better than we did in the last two".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Jeremie #Boga to 'Sky Sport': "Do I often look for the goal from that position? Yes, it is a position I always look for, I try to shoot more. Today, I think I took 3 shots, this is what I need to do, consistency, trying to score, being more decisive for the team and helping out more. It is something I work on often and try to execute. I tried it earlier too, on another curling shot I came close, but not as close as on the goal. I think it's something I always try to do. When you score it's great, when you don't it's ugly, but I have to keep trying".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Jeremie #Boga to 'Sky Sport': "When all three forwards score, does it mean things are working? Yes, I think we played the match very well today. In the first 20 minutes, it was a bit tough, we had some trouble with their pressing, then we pushed forward, and did the right things. Yes, for us up front scoring is always a pleasure, seeing all the attackers find the net is always great for the team, and I'm very happy today for all of us".[@juventusinsidernews]

HERE IS #EKHATOR (A playful pun combining Ecco with Ekhator)#Juve is secondEuropa League: #Spalletti beats #Omonia Nicosia 4-1, fourth victory in five matches.#Ekhator promoted: a debut like a true number 9Lucio falls behind after a mistake by #Neto. #Cambiaso responds. Then the ex #Genoa celebrates on his first start. #Conceição and #Boga complete the four-goal rout.[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

#JUVE, NEW GOALS#Cambiaso and #Ekhator spark the comeback against #Omonia#Neto's early mistake does not ruin the evening. A masterpiece by the wing-back, then the young striker (substituted in the second half due to muscle discomfort) seizes his opportunity: movement and finish of a true center-forward. #Spalletti discovers extra resources and smiles: "Well done, boys!" #Conceição and #Boga also find the net again. Fourth victory in Europe and 2nd place: round of 16 within reach.[Front Page TuttoSport]

🗣 Francisco #Conceição to 'Sky Sport': "What did I think after the goal? I wanted to thank the entire staff who did a great job with my recovery, it's always a difficult time for me because I suffer a lot when I'm sidelined. Because I love playing so much and I suffer a bit more than I should, so I wanted to thank them. I dedicated the goal to my family who were in the stands because they know all the tough moments that happen behind an injury and they are there every single day, like 24 hours a day, suffering alongside me and this joy is for them, as they deserve it. It is the best possible way to wipe away 40 days off the pitch".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Francisco #Conceição to 'Sky Sport': "Will #Ekhator remember my assist for the rest of his life? Yes, of course. I think we worked all week on this exact situation as well, on positioning ourselves there, somewhat centrally on the pitch, behind Omonia's central midfielder. I tried to push up at that moment, I turned and I saw #Ekhator's run. He scored a great goal, he deserves it: he always works harder and is an exceptional guy, off the pitch too. I'm happy for the assist, for him and for the team".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Francisco #Conceição to 'Sky Sport': "How eager was I to step onto the pitch, play and score? I haven't been able to do what I love for about a month, and I felt such a strong desire to come back. I truly had the craving to play, it's what I love doing. I am happy to have helped the team. We won and that is the most important thing. We earned another 3 points in the Europa League and we want to stay in the top part of the table. In Europe, all games are tough, we have to keep going like this. Now we have the league, and then we'll turn our focus back to this competition to finish in the top 8 and avoid playing 2 extra matches".[@juventusinsidernews]

🚨 Excl. - #Inter, #Juventus, #Napoli, #Fiorentina, #Como, #Sassuolo and #Monza are monitoring the young striker Lorenzo #Mezzotero (born in 2008), who has scored 4 goals in the last 4 games with #Sampdoria. Several Scouts have been sent to watch Samp’s matches in the last weeks[Nico Schira]

👀 #Juventus was left down a player for one minute at #Omonia Nicosia.The bianconeri fell victim to the new substitution rule.#Spalletti took off #Conceição to bring on #KoloMuani, but the number 7 took more than 10 seconds to leave the pitch.The referee stopped everything and forced the Frenchman to stay on the sideline for one minute before letting him come on.[@DiMarzio via @PuebloJ]
